candidates.change_summary: Change final returned boolean from true to false so transfer(...) always returns false when it completes.
Return the success flag of the last low-level call instead of a constant true so the return value reflects the last call outcome when no revert occurred.
Change the call to use delegatecall instead of call, so external contract execution runs in this contract's context and can alter this contract's state or behavior observable via transfer.
Use staticcall instead of call, preventing state changes in the target and potentially causing different revert/return behavior observable via transfer.
Remove the require that _tos.length > 0, allowing transfer to accept empty _tos and return true, changing observable behavior when called with empty arrays.
Change the revert to continue (remove revert) so failed external calls do not revert the whole transfer, altering observable outcome when some calls fail.
